items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: It was a white teacher teaching us. Professor Scott from - you know that school too - Agnes Scott College in Atlanta, Georgia.

ctx.x: What other musicians did you play with then? We asked you about some of the other fellows that you played with in the band.
It was a white teacher teaching us. Professor Scott from - you know that school too - Agnes Scott College in Atlanta, Georgia. I know you heard of that. It was a white school. He was teaching us.
In what year? Can you remember the year that you left Atlanta?
